title: TypeScript for Dynamics 365
description: A six-part guide to writing Dynamics 365 web resources with TypeScript: basics, declarations, bundling, modules, unit tests and Application Insights.
intro: A practical approach to building web resources that are easier to maintain, test and support.
context: This series grew out of projects where JavaScript web resources had become difficult to maintain. TypeScript, testing and telemetry help bring structure to that work.
These articles reflect the tools and APIs available when they were written. The code and downloadable samples are preserved with their original context.
